nodes.name: Error Trigger
nodes.notes: Fires when any workflow that names this one as its Error Workflow fails with an UNHANDLED error. Handled errors - nodes with an error output wired - never reach here by design; those are reported inside the workflow itself.

nodes.name: Code - Build Failure Report
nodes.notes: Flattens the Error Trigger payload. Handles both the execution-failure and trigger-failure shapes, and clips the stack trace so a huge trace cannot make the notification itself fail.

nodes.name: Slack - Workflow Failure Alert
nodes.notes: Primary notification. Retries three times first, so a transient Slack blip does not immediately escalate to email. If it still fails, output 2 hands over to the email fallback - a Slack outage must not swallow the only alert.

parameters.subject: =n8n failure: {{ $('Code - Build Failure Report').first().json.workflowName }} ({{ $('Code - Build Failure Report').first().json.failedNode }})

nodes.name: Email - Workflow Failure Fallback
nodes.notes: Out-of-band fallback on a different transport. Reads the report by node name rather than from the Slack error item, so it does not depend on the shape of an error payload. Left on the default stopWorkflow: if email fails too, this run goes red, which is the last remaining signal.
